name: String Music of the World
subtitle: Charango, Morin khuur & more
shortDescription: 11 traditions to play: Charango, Joropo llanero band, Morin khuur and Dan bau.
longDescription:
String Music of the World: 11 traditional games and crafts from 20 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Charango, Joropo llanero band, Morin khuur, Dan bau, Panduri, Balalaika, Kamancha, Qanun, Buzuq Long-Neck Lute, Rabab plucked lute and Goje One-String Fiddle.

Each game has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can play instruments and dances, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
